atten3.ptxt: Be sure to perform a function inspection after assembling the throttle body or removing and installing its components.

s2.ptxt: Remove the EFI fuse and ETCS fuse at the same time, and connect the fuses after 60 seconds or more have elapsed.
After installing the throttle body to the vehicle, turn the IG ON without operating the accelerator pedal.

atten3.ptxt: If the accelerator pedal is operated, start over from removal of the EFI fuse and ETCS fuse above.

s2.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3 and clear the DTCs.
Start the engine, and check that the check engine warning light is not illuminated and that the idle speed is within the standard when the A/C is turned ON → OFF after warm-up.

item.ptxt: Perform in the N or P position.

s2.ptxt: When the accelerator pedal is quickly depressed to near full open, check that the value of [ECU Data Monitor] - [Throttle Sensor No.1 Opening (THP1)] is 60% or more.
Perform a road test and check that there is nothing unusual.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Camshaft Oil Control Valve Assembly Operation

s2.ptxt: Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve Assembly (Intake Side)

s3.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [Active Test] - [VVT Control].
With the engine idling, check the idle speed for [Not Performed/Performed].

s2.ptxt: Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve Assembly (Exhaust Side)

s3.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [Active Test] - [Exhaust VVT Linear Drive Bank 1].
With the engine idling, check the idle speed when the exhaust side VVT is advanced and retarded.

entry.ptxt: Advanced and retarded between -100 (advance side) ←→ 100% (retard side)

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Intake Air Flow Meter Sub-assembly Function

item.ptxt: Inspect the intake air flow meter sub-assembly according to the following procedure.

If [ECU Data Monitor] - [Intake Air Amount] is outside the standard with the engine stopped, or if foreign matter is found on the platinum filament (heater) portion of the intake air flow meter sub-assembly, replace the intake air flow meter sub-assembly.
Inspect indoors with the vehicle level and the engine stopped.
Perform the inspection with the intake air flow meter sub-assembly installed to the air cleaner case (installed on the vehicle).
Do not extract exhaust from the exhaust tail pipe with an exhaust duct.

s3.ptxt: Turn the IG ON and wait for 30 seconds. (Engine stopped)
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Intake Air Amount] and read the intake air amount.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Accelerator Pedal Sensor Assembly Function

s3.ptxt: Turn the IG ON with the engine stopped.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Accelerator Sensor No.1 Voltage (VPA1)] and check the voltage with the accelerator fully closed.
Turn the IG ON with the engine stopped.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Throttle Sensor No.1 Opening (THPS)] and check the opening.

entry.ptxt: Accelerator pedal fully closed → fully open
